title: Why we're raising The House Fund
summary: We don't have our recovery home yet. Here's where things stand, and how your gift helps us get there.

body.text: Since The Braid began, our goal has been a safe, dignified recovery home in Lee County — a place where people can rest, recover and rise with real support around them.

We want to be straightforward with you: we don't have that home yet. Securing a house takes funding, the right property and approvals, and we're not there. Rather than announce a house before it's ready, we're asking our community to help us build The House Fund.

items: Securing the house — a down payment or lease, deposits, and the repairs and inspections a recovery home needs.
Furnishing it — beds, linens, kitchen equipment and household basics.
First-year support — case management, utilities and operating costs so residents get real help from day one.

body.text: Our case managers keep working today. We help people make a plan, connect them with partner beds through the Lee County Continuum of Care, and link them to healthcare, benefits and work.
Give to The House Fund — once or monthly. Share it with your masjid, church or workplace. And if you know of a property that could become a recovery home, tell us.

title: How to refer someone to The Braid
summary: A short guide for case managers, providers, faith leaders and families in Lee County.

body.text: Many of the people we serve come to us through someone who cared enough to make a call — a case manager, a counselor, an imam or pastor, a nurse, or a family member. Here's how to refer someone.
Talk with the person and get their permission to share their information with us. A referral works best when the person wants it.
Start a request on our secure intake site, or call our intake line. Only The Braid's case managers can see what you send.
A case manager reaches out to the person directly. With their consent, we'll keep you updated.
What we can help with today

items: Case management and a personal plan
Connection to partner beds through the Continuum of Care
Healthcare, mental health and benefits navigation
Confidential support for domestic violence and trafficking survivors

body.text: We don't have our own recovery home yet — we're raising The House Fund to secure one. We never pay for referrals, and never accept payment for them.
